name: Izumi Chiaki
source: Third-year student at Houjou University majoring in literature. A tomboy with a carefree and lazy attitude, she often freeloads off Haruki and skips class. Despite her irresponsible behavior, she occasionally surprises him with moments of sharp insight and an unexpected depth of emotional intelligence.
